newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong gold ends shade up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends shade up in light trade.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended Thursday a shade up from New York's previous close after light amounts of Asian buying and some physical demand, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$318.10/60 on Thursday compared to New York's previous close at US$317.80/318.30 on Wednesday.
"It's barely changed from New York's close," said one Chinese trader, noting he had had a very quiet day.
Dealers said gold was stuck in a one-dollar range and dropped slightly after London opened in the afternoon.
Physical demand was light, but steady, dealers said.
Market sources saw gold heading south on a persistently bearish mood.
Local tael gold ended HK$13 down at HK$2,952.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to nil from its previous fix at +3.00.
